challenge.name: The Push-Up Challenge
challenge.cause: The Push for Better Foundation (mental health)
challenge.substitution: standing 8kg dumbbell curls (8.5kg/rep) instead of push-ups

fun.totalLine: 16 t hoisted so far — about a double-decker bus 🚌
fun.heaviestLine: 50 reps in one go = 425 kg (2× a grand piano 🎹)
fun.tonneLine: 16 tonnes of iron, one rep at a time. Not bad for a push-up challenge. 💪
fun.workLine: Mechanical lift work: 124 kJ, arm by arm, rep by rep, kJ by JK. 💪
fun.burnLine: Estimated workout burn: 900 kJ (~215 kcal): 600 kJ lifting + 300 kJ controlled lowering.
fun.teaLine: lift work could boil 1.5 mugs of tea; with controlled lowering, body burn is more like 10.7 mugs ☕

work.note: mass × gravity × ~0.8 m upward lift only; controlled descent is counted in workout burn

workoutBurn.note: lifting burn uses ~20% concentric efficiency; controlled lowering adds 50% of lifting burn, rounded to the nearest 50 kJ
